headline: Bitcoin holds near $65,000 after a steep Wall Street sell-off led by chip stocks, December Fed rate-hike odds stay above 90%, and the CFTC approves blockchain-based US derivatives exchanges.

market.asOf: Read at about 23:56 UTC Mon 16 Nov (about 06:56 Tue Bangkok) from the CoinGecko homepage and CoinMarketCap's charts page; CoinGecko prices shown. CoinMarketCap had BTC at $65,251. The 24-hour change is left out because the pages read did not show whether it was up or down. Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: CoinMarketCap's Fear & Greed index read 13 at about 23:56 UTC Mon 16 Nov. CoinDesk reported the index at 12 ('extreme fear') earlier on Monday.

stories.title: Wall Street sell-off led by chip stocks keeps bitcoin pinned near $65,000
stories.summary: US stocks fell sharply on Monday, led by chipmakers, a day before Nvidia reports results. Bitcoin was roughly flat near $65,000, while shares of crypto companies fell much harder. Nvidia's numbers on Tuesday evening US time are the next big event for markets.
points: The Nasdaq closed down 2.5% at 24,509.76 and the S&P 500 down 1.9% at 7,416.59, its third straight loss, per the AP's market table.
Chip stocks led the fall: Nvidia -4.12%, Micron -7.62% and Intel -7.02%, per StockTitan.
Bitcoin was at $65,225 (down 0.2%) at 6pm ET, per Investing.com. Over seven days BTC is down 13.2%, ETH 14.6% and SOL 17.5%, per Yahoo Finance.
Strategy shares fell 8% to $102.50 and Coinbase 7% to $118.40 in Monday morning trading, per Yahoo Finance.

sources.label: AP via mymotherlode: how US indexes fared

stories.title: December Fed rate rise priced in as long-term US yields stay above 5%; Fed minutes due Wednesday
stories.summary: Traders expect the Fed to raise interest rates in December, and the 10-year US Treasury yield is above 5%. Higher rates make assets that pay no interest, like bitcoin, less attractive. Wednesday's minutes from the October Fed meeting are the next clue.
points: CME FedWatch showed a 92% chance of a 0.25-point rise on 9 December, per Finwire. That is a market bet, not a Fed decision.
October core inflation rose 0.3% on the month, above the 0.2% forecast, per Finwire.
Treasury Secretary Bessent urged the Fed to look past energy-driven inflation; Chicago Fed President Goolsbee said price pressures go beyond energy, per Finwire.
Fed Governor Waller speaks Tuesday at 9:10am ET, per the Federal Reserve, and the October minutes come out Wednesday at 2pm ET.

stories.title: US regulator approves blockchain-based derivatives exchanges run by Backpack and tZERO
stories.summary: The CFTC, the US regulator for futures and other derivatives, approved Backpack and tZERO to run regulated exchanges and clearinghouses that trade and settle on blockchain systems. The CFTC chair said such approvals show 'there is a regulated pathway for a new generation of market infrastructure'.
points: CFTC Chair Michael Selig called the approvals 'an important milestone in the evolution of American financial markets'; his statement did not name the firms, per The Block.
tZERO's exchange approval came the week before and it already held clearinghouse approval; Backpack announced its approval on Monday, per The Block.
Selig is the CFTC's only sitting commissioner; a Senate Agriculture hearing for two nominees, Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland, is set for Tuesday, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: CFTC approves Backpack and tZERO

briefs.title: Lighter resumes withdrawals
briefs.summary: Lighter turned off its withdrawal pause and returned about $5M USDC to the affected trader. The total loss is still unconfirmed: $10.4M traced, or up to $15.5M across two accounts by other estimates, per Crypto Briefing.

briefs.title: $2B weekend liquidation flush
briefs.summary: About $2B of trades, mostly bets on rising prices, were forcibly closed over the weekend as bitcoin fell to $62,100, its lowest since 14 July, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows: seven days running
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $185.4M on Friday 13 November, their seventh straight day of outflows, per Farside data cited by CoinReporter. Monday's figures had not been confirmed when this was written.

briefs.title: Strategy below its average cost
briefs.summary: Strategy holds 850,849 BTC at an average cost of $75,452, above the current price, and MSCI drops it from its indexes after the close on 30 November, per Yahoo Finance.

briefs.title: Senators question SEC tokenized-stock exemption
briefs.summary: Four Democratic senators wrote to SEC Chair Atkins about anti-money-laundering gaps in the SEC's exemption for tokenized stocks, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kava Lend exploit
briefs.summary: An attacker borrowed about 55.2M KAVA (about $3.76M) through a little-used market, and KAVA fell about 40% in 24 hours, per BitcoinWorld.

briefs.title: Russia opens crypto to ordinary investors
briefs.summary: From 17 November non-qualified retail investors in Russia can buy BTC, ETH and USDT up to annual limits, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Arbitrum vote on frozen Binance-hack funds
briefs.summary: An Arbitrum DAO vote on returning 8,425.997 ETH and about 74.56M ARB to Binance, subject to legal indemnification, was due to end 16 November, per CoinDesk. No result had been reported when this was written.
